decisions.decision: Wire skill.Registry (NOT skill.Loader) as the listing/reload signal source. Loader stays for wizard-commit registration confirmation + chat findSkill + agent construction; Registry is additive for the listing/reload path.
decisions.rationale: Registry already has correct, TESTED fsnotify + per-skill Entry.Version + graceful per-file failure. Dual startup scan (~1 skill) is negligible.

decisions.decision: Replace time.Now().UnixNano() Entry.Version with a per-process monotonic atomic.Int64 counter (from 1).
decisions.rationale: UnixNano (~1.7e18 > 2^53) makes a +1 reload bump INVISIBLE to JS (ULP≈512). Counter keeps every Version well under 2^53. All existing registry_test.go assertions are RELATIVE so the counter satisfies every one.

decisions.decision: Surface reload failures via a copy-on-write Registry.failed map (name→err.Error()), overlaid as status:"failed" in the HTTP listing, WITHOUT bumping Entry.Version.
decisions.rationale: T4 + T6 pin keep-old: on failure Version AND manifest MUST stay unchanged.

decisions.decision: Added exported Registry.Reload(path) (wraps reloadOne) as the public synchronous-reload API.
decisions.rationale: Same-package reloadOne is unreachable from the server package tests; Reload is a legit public API for server tests + any future admin/trigger path.
